messages:
omar: ACME replayed an hourly export into our ingest window. Ledger recon shows a few accounts with negative net deltas. Can someone take this?

katie: Can you drop a sample payload? My bet is retries created new event_ids so our event_id dedupe missed them.

acme-ing-engineer: Sorry  we had a retry storm and re-posted ~1.1k events with new uuids. Sample: {"customer_id":"cust-101","usage":500,"ts":"2026-08-03T01:00:00Z","event_id":"evt-retry-123"}

claire: From dry reconcile: 6 accounts affected, net over-credit ~5,400 units. I'll open an exception and run full diffs.

billing-ops-bot: EX-2026-901 created and assigned to @claire (SLA 48h).

sam: Support drafting customer note: apology, visible billing portal impact, ETA for fix + credits. Posting to #support-drafts in 15m.

omar: Short-term actions: (1) require X-Partner-Replay header for bulk replays (reject w/422 if missing), (2) partner to preserve event_id on retries, (3) billing ops manual reconciliation. @katie can you scope the ingest guard?

katie: Will add a quick reject rule and alert for replay spikes. Patching canary in next 90m. Also updating Partner Integration Spec to require replay header and example curl.

claire: Dry-run SQL and diffs posted to EX-2026-901. Applying manual reversals with audit IDs now. Keeping ticket open 48h for verification.

omar: Thanks team. Schedule 30m sync with ACME PM tomorrow to agree replay SLA and test vectors. Closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
